ai.title: Plan with AI TravelMate
ai.text: Describe your trip in your own words: days, budget, who's coming and what you love. Ask follow-ups to change anything.
ai.setPrefs: Tip: save your travel preferences for more personal plans.
ai.hello: Hi! Tell me where you'd like to go, for how long, your budget and what you enjoy. I'll draft a route, stays, activities, costs and a day-by-day plan. You can also ask me to compare destinations or about the best time to go.
ai.ex1: I have $2,500, seven days and I want wildlife, culture and beaches.
ai.ex2: 5-day luxury safari in Tanzania for two people
ai.ex3: Family trip to Zanzibar for 4, 6 days, under $4,000
ai.error: We couldn't create a plan right now. Please try again.
ai.placeholder: e.g. 10 days in Tanzania for two, wildlife and beaches, around $6,000
ai.followPh: Ask for changes: cheaper, add a beach day, 3 people…
ai.disclaimer: Demo planner: AI TravelMate builds plans from TravelMateVR’s own catalogue with transparent rules. Prices are estimates until you book.
ai.overBudget: Estimated total {{total}}, above your {{budget}} budget. Ask for “cheaper” or fewer days.
ai.noStay: Stay arranged with your operator in {{place}}
ai.costNote: Estimates before taxes on individual bookings. International flights not included.
ai.seasonAnswer: The best time to visit {{place}} is {{months}}.
ai.noEntry: I don't have entry information for that country yet.
ai.weatherAnswer: In {{month}}, {{place}} typically reaches about {{high}}°C with around {{rain}} mm of rain.
ai.goodMonth: It's one of the best months to go.
ai.notIdeal: It's outside the peak season, so expect fewer visitors and some rain.

reason.season: {{place}} is outside its best season in your likely travel month.
reason.downgraded: I chose more affordable stays to keep the plan closer to your budget.

sus.community_one: {{count}} community-led or locally owned experience is included.
sus.community_other: {{count}} community-led or locally owned experiences are included.
sus.contribution: About USD {{amount}} goes to conservation and community funds through these bookings.
sus.flights: The route includes a flight; you can ask for an overland alternative.
sus.general: Travel with local guides, keep wildlife distances and ask before photographing people.

assume.dates: Dates start about six weeks from today; change them in the itinerary.

ai.paused: AI TravelMate is paused for maintenance. You can still browse destinations and build an itinerary yourself.
ai.noPartners: TravelMateVR has no bookable partners in {{places}} yet, so this plan uses free time and leaves stays and tours to arrange yourself.

plan.title: Plan My Journey
plan.text: Create a trip, let AI draft the days, then arrange everything yourself: drag activities, change stays, see costs and book.
plan.name: Trip name
plan.destHint: Leave empty to let AI suggest destinations.
plan.errDates: Choose an end date on or after the start date.
plan.dragHint: Drag activities between times and days, or use the arrows. Changes save automatically on this device.
plan.deleteText: “{{name}}” will be removed. Bookings stay in your bookings list.
plan.shareNote: Shared links open the trip for people signed in to your account. Public sharing will be available once accounts sync.
plan.bookText: Book items one by one. Each booking is confirmed with the partner and appears in your Trip Control Center.

cost.title: Estimated cost
cost.note: Estimates before taxes and fees. The exact price is shown when you book.

price.noHidden: No hidden fees: this is the full price.
price.indicativeNote: Indicative price: the partner confirms the final amount before you pay.

book.title: Complete your booking
book.rooms_one: {{count}} room will be booked for your group.
book.rooms_other: {{count}} rooms will be booked for your group.
book.noExtras: No extras are offered for this booking.
book.guestNote: You're booking as a guest. Sign in to keep this booking with your account.
book.phoneHint: For WhatsApp or SMS updates during your trip.
book.travellerNames: Names of all travellers (as on passports)
book.privacy: We only share your name and contact details with the partner providing this booking.
book.errPhone: Enter a valid phone number with country code.
book.errAgree: Please accept the terms to continue.
book.agree: I agree to the booking terms, the cancellation policy and the privacy policy.
book.demoPayment: Preview checkout: no money is taken. In the live service, payments run through a licensed Tanzanian payment provider, and TravelMateVR never sees your card number or PIN.
book.requestPayment: You won't be charged until {{partner}} confirms your request.
book.deposit: Pay a {{rate}}% deposit now ({{amount}}) and the rest later
book.secure1: Payments are processed by a PCI-compliant payment partner; TravelMateVR never stores card numbers.
book.secure2: You'll get a booking ID, receipt and QR confirmation straight away.
book.securingText: This takes a few seconds. Please keep this page open.
book.error: We couldn't complete your booking. Nothing was charged. Please try again.

card.title: Visa or Mastercard
card.text: cards from any bank, including CRDB, NMB, NBC, Stanbic and TCB

mobile_money.title: Mobile money
mobile_money.text: M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Mixx by Yas and others: approve on your phone.

bank_transfer.title: Bank transfer
bank_transfer.text: We'll send account details; your booking is held for 72 hours.

pay_later.title: Reserve now, pay later
pay_later.text: No payment today; pay before the date shown on your confirmation.

pay.momoHint: The number registered for mobile money. You'll get a prompt to enter your PIN.
pay.errPhone: Enter a Tanzanian mobile number, for example 0754 123 456.
pay.tzsNote: You'll approve about {{tzs}} ({{usd}}). Your network confirms the exact shilling amount.
pay.cardNote: You'll enter your card details on our payment partner's secure page (3-D Secure). TravelMateVR never sees your card number.
pay.banksNote: Direct payments from {{banks}} and other Tanzanian banks are coming soon. Until then, pay with mobile money or your bank's Visa or Mastercard card.
pay.approveText: We've sent a payment request through {{network}} for {{amount}} ({{usd}}) to {{phone}}. Enter your PIN on your phone to approve it.
pay.approveFallback: No prompt? Dial {{ussd}} for {{network}}, approve the pending payment from the menu, then come back here.
pay.cardText: Pay {{amount}} on our payment partner's secure card page, then come back here.
pay.demoNote: Preview: no payment request is sent and nothing is charged. In the live service, your network or bank confirms the payment automatically.

confirm.title: Booking {{id}}
confirm.bookedText: We've sent your confirmation to {{email}}. It's also saved in My Trips, available offline.
confirm.requestedText: {{partner}} will confirm availability. We'll notify you as soon as they reply.
confirm.qrHint: Show this at check-in or pick-up.
confirm.pendingNote: Awaiting confirmation from {{partner}}. You can cancel free of charge until then.
confirm.bankNote: Use {{id}} as the payment reference for your bank transfer.
confirm.refunded: This booking was cancelled and a refund issued to your original payment method.
confirm.paidToast: Payment received. Your booking is fully paid.
confirm.whatsapp: Hello TravelMateVR, I have a question about booking {{id}} ({{title}}).
confirm.refundPreview: Under the cancellation policy you'll get {{amount}} back of the {{paid}} paid.
confirm.nothingPaid: Nothing has been paid, so there's no charge to cancel.
confirm.deleteText: This removes “{{title}}” from your account permanently. It can't be undone.

trips.title: My Trips
trips.text: Upcoming trips, drafts and past journeys, with everything you need on the way.
trips.emptyText: Plan a trip with AI or build one day by day.
trips.offline: Trips, itineraries and booking references are saved on this device and open even without a connection.

control.nothingPlanned: Nothing planned yet for this day.
control.noBookings: No bookings yet for this trip.
control.weatherNote: Typical conditions based on long-term averages. Check a local forecast a few days before.
control.mapOffline: The map needs a connection. Your itinerary and bookings are still available.
control.whatsapp: Hello TravelMateVR, I need help during my trip “{{trip}}”.
control.embassy: Register with your embassy if your country offers it, and keep copies of your passport and insurance.
control.noDocs: No documents linked to this trip yet.
